subject: Modular virtual full-loop: rolling panel rotation + shadow-fill policy
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@nimbanalytix.com>; Alex Gomez <agomez+recruiting@example.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2027 09:21:00 -0700
Subject: Modular virtual full-loop: rolling panel rotation + shadow-fill policy

Team —

Quick plan for tomorrow's full-loop with Alex (Nimbanalytix). We need a lightweight, timeboxed flow that allows a rotating "shadow" interviewer to step in if someone has to drop — goal: keep candidate experience smooth and the loop on time. I've attached a slot_matrix_v2.xlsx and a short brief (panel_quick_brief.md).

High-level: 
- 4 modules (30 / 30 / 30 / 15) with 10-minute buffer lanes between modules for lateboarding or quick handoffs.
- One primary for each module + one shadow assigned to module 2 and 3. Shadow will only step in after a 5-min grace window & announce with the candidate.
- Debrief cadence: 15 min synchronous after the loop with scribe notes collected in the doc; asynchronous rubric if people can’t join.

Asks:
1) Karthik — can you take primary for Module 1 (system design) and be shadow for Module 3?
2) Laura — primary Module 2 (infra/runtime), please hold standby for any slot swaps.
3) Neha — own scheduling updates and confirm calendar invites; please upload final agenda to the Drive link.

Candidate-facing invite will go out once everyone confirms. Note: Priya (hiring manager) is looped for visibility; she may join Module 4 for final Q&A.

Thanks —
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Recruiting Operations Lead, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai

Attachments: slot_matrix_v2.xlsx, panel_quick_brief.md, candidate_resume_alexg.pdf
